nodes.title: ddRADSeq
nodes.scope: Illumina ddRADSeq drawing and catalogue text, with a separately labeled primary-paper resolution. The d_ route preserves the depicted sequential digests; the p_ route records Peterson et al.'s simultaneous double digest. They are evidence views of the same ddRAD/ddRADSeq assay, not two validated interchangeable variants or parallel reactions on one sample. Genomic DNA fragments carry restriction-adjacent sequence for SNP discovery and genotyping. Other related applications and RAD-family names are not assigned the depicted workflow.
